reviews.title: Poor Handling of Scrambles
reviews.text:
If a player drops out of a 4-person scramble team, the team handicap index goes DOWN in Golf Genius. In what universe does that make sense?  Why would a 3 person team give up more strokes to the full teams?

GG blames the USGA by stating that they are following USGA guidelines.  That's incorrect.  GG implemented the USGA calculation for a 3 person scramble tournament  into their calculation for a missing person in a 4 person scramble.  Not the same thing boys and girls.

I've had a series of chats/email with GG support.  After several times repeating their canned response to this obviously repeat question, one support staff told me he'd escalate the issue.  I heard nothing back.

Our leagues have had to work around by giving mulligans to 3-person teams.  Still a sore spot in league play and a constant critique of  Golf Genius by members.

reviews.title: Functionality Good, Usability Bad
reviews.text:
This app could be so great, but it needs a lot of improvement for usability. Trying to use this to navigate things like league standings and such is so tedious. Trying to use this on a phone is also hard as they have no optimization for portrait so choice is a lot of side scrolling with no frozen columns (so don’t forget what row you are looking at) or have to use in landscape.

It is nice to have live scoring, but hopefully a lot of effort is going into making it easier to navigate and use.

reviews.title: Mostly Great
reviews.text:
Our club started using Golf Genius and after a bit of resistance, most have embraced it.  I love it for scoring and mid tournament management. 
I do not love it for event registration.  The font for invites and announcements is tiny and golfers are mostly old. It makes me hate seeing a golf genius email. This seems like a simple fix.
One more thing.  At the end of a tournament, the choices are review scores and score summary. Please edit one of these options to say: scores are turned in and you are finished and you can go have a drink.  “Score summary” sounds like there are most steps to be done to turn in your card.  
Golf Genius has helped our club and our staff and thanks.
